previewCoverage.title: Dashboard cards
previewCoverage.followUp: Expand the rendered block into the full preview-02 dashboard card grid when dashboard composition parity is graded.

previewCoverage.title: Sidebar/navigation
previewCoverage.followUp: Expand the Theme Studio shell after sidebar layout parity is graded against preview-02.

previewCoverage.title: Contribution/activity chart
previewCoverage.reason: The create page uses a source-specific contribution bar chart that is not yet represented as a downloadable registry example.
previewCoverage.followUp: Add an activity chart example with source-backed visual parity.

previewCoverage.title: Payout threshold
previewCoverage.reason: Existing slider/select/input examples cover the primitive dependencies, but the full payout settings card is not a source-owned block yet.
previewCoverage.followUp: Compose a payout threshold block after select, textarea, and slider visual parity are reviewed together.

previewCoverage.title: Savings targets
previewCoverage.reason: Progress primitives are downloadable, but the savings target card stack needs a source-owned composed example.
previewCoverage.followUp: Add a savings targets block when card/progress composition parity is graded.

previewCoverage.title: Buy investment
previewCoverage.reason: Input and select examples are downloadable, but the investment order card is not a source-owned block.
previewCoverage.followUp: Add the buy investment block after form and list-row visual parity are reconciled.

previewCoverage.title: Distribute track/upload empty state
previewCoverage.reason: File input is downloadable, but the empty release/distribution card is not a source-owned composed block.
previewCoverage.followUp: Add a release upload empty-state block after upload-zone styling is source-owned.

previewCoverage.title: Claimable balance
previewCoverage.reason: Card and badge primitives are downloadable, but the claimable balance summary is not yet a source-owned block.
previewCoverage.followUp: Add the claimable balance block when summary-card visual parity is reviewed.

previewCoverage.title: QR/device connection card
previewCoverage.reason: No source-owned QR/device connection registry payload exists yet.
previewCoverage.followUp: Add a QR/device connection block after QR rendering is source-owned.

previewCoverage.title: Recent transactions
previewCoverage.reason: Data table/list primitives are downloadable, but the exact recent transactions card is not source-owned yet.
previewCoverage.followUp: Add transaction list composition after list-row and table visual parity are reviewed.

previewCoverage.title: Sidebar/theme card
previewCoverage.followUp: Promote origin theme-card controls as source-backed variants land.

previewCoverage.title: Preset/actions
previewCoverage.followUp: Wire preset import/export once source-owned preset payload metadata exists.

previewCoverage.title: Preview switcher 01
previewCoverage.reason: Tabs primitives are downloadable, but create preview variant 01 is not a separate source-owned page block yet.
previewCoverage.followUp: Add create preview 01 as a page-level block when its source inventory is checked in.

previewCoverage.title: Preview switcher 02
previewCoverage.reason: Tabs primitives are downloadable, but create preview variant 02 is represented by this initial block inventory rather than a separate page-level registry item.
previewCoverage.followUp: Split preview 02 into a source-owned page block after plan 026 visual parity work.

previewCoverage.title: Progress cards
previewCoverage.followUp: Broaden card-level progress layouts when preview-02 card composition parity is available.

previewCoverage.title: Transaction/investment lists
previewCoverage.reason: The registry has tables and cards, but not the preview-02 transaction/investment list block as a downloadable example.
previewCoverage.followUp: Add list-block examples once list visual parity is reviewed.

previewCoverage.title: Preference forms
previewCoverage.followUp: Fold in the complete preview-02 preferences form when field grouping parity is complete.

previewCoverage.title: Switches
previewCoverage.followUp: Expand the settings block once switch grouping parity is reviewed against preview-02.

previewCoverage.title: Selects/comboboxes
previewCoverage.followUp: Add combobox-specific source-owned payloads when that slice is available.

previewCoverage.title: Tabs
previewCoverage.followUp: Expand to the preview-02 dashboard tab layout when block composition parity exists.

previewCoverage.title: Accordions
previewCoverage.followUp: Promote more accordion variants as preview-02 details are reconciled.

previewCoverage.title: Dropdown/menu actions
previewCoverage.followUp: Add interactive menu state when composed menu parity is source-owned.

previewCoverage.title: Calendar/date controls
previewCoverage.followUp: Broaden to date-picker range controls when source-owned grouping is complete.

previewCoverage.title: Radio groups
previewCoverage.followUp: Replace the static radio-card surface once payment-card grouping parity is source-owned.

previewCoverage.title: Checkboxes
previewCoverage.followUp: Broaden checklist grouping when preview-02 permissions composition is represented as a registry example.

previewCoverage.title: Sliders
previewCoverage.followUp: Pair with switch controls when the smart-home card registry payload is source-owned.

previewCoverage.title: Upload controls
previewCoverage.followUp: Replace the static upload-zone preview once upload-zone styling is represented by a source-owned block.

previewCoverage.title: Payment method controls
previewCoverage.reason: Payment method card composition is not yet a source-owned registry payload.
previewCoverage.followUp: Add payment method controls after radio-card and form grouping parity are complete.

previewCoverage.title: Profile/security forms
previewCoverage.followUp: Split profile and security examples if future registry payloads become source-owned.

previewCoverage.title: Smart-home controls
previewCoverage.reason: No source-owned smart-home card registry payload exists yet.
previewCoverage.followUp: Add a smart-home controls block after switch, slider, and card composition parity are reviewed together.

previewCoverage.title: Modal/drawer-like surfaces
previewCoverage.followUp: Add interactive modal or drawer state after preview-02 modal/drawer composition is source-owned.
